An open, unauthenticated model endpoint is how AI apps get expensive overnight.

Require auth, then enforce a per-user limit with a Redis token bucket, cap how many model calls run at once, and track spend per user with a global kill switch behind it. When a caller goes over, return HTTP 429 with a Retry-After header. And set the provider's own hard spend cap on day one, before you write any code.
